sloka: ते क्षिप्रम् अभिगम्य अथ यूथपा यूथपर्षभम् ।हरयो वानर श्रेष्ठम् परिवार्य उपतस्थिरे ॥४-२-८॥
transliteration: te kṣipram abhigamya atha yūthapā yūthaparṣabham ।harayo vānara śreṣṭham parivārya upatasthire ॥4-2-8॥

translations.english: The leaders of the monkey troops reached Sugriva, the lord of monkeys, in no time and stood surrounding him.
